submission.comment: Best strategy found: MA crossover with fast=50, slow=280, long_only=True. This strategy achieves an annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.184 with 66.1% annual return, 55.8% annual volatility, and a max drawdown of 43.0%. The strategy has very low turnover (0.14% daily) and stays invested 70.8% of the time. Tested 191 total strategy combinations across all families.
